Price has pushed to 1.42, extending the grind above the 1.39 lower pivot and keeping the short entry at 1.39 invalidated — the bearish continuation to 1.25 has still not triggered. Nothing structural changed from the prior read: FVGs remain cleared, the 1H trend is up, and the regime stays BULLISH, while the 4H remains bearish and the combined signal stays HOLD, so this is still a 1.39–1.53 range rather than a resolved trend. Bias stays cautiously long-side within the range: holding 1.39 keeps the reclaim toward 1.53 alive, and only a decisive loss of 1.39 reopens 1.25 and restores the short case.
